suit_heater: Prop concept sheet of ONE dwarven suit module, the SUIT HEATER: a compact heating unit that straps to a dwarf's belt or armour. A glowing orange resonance-crystal heating coil inside a riveted dark iron cage, wrapped in shaggy grey-white woolly hide bound with leather straps and brass buckles, a small brass dial and a vented grille where warm orange light leaks out. About the size of a large canteen. Show front, side, back and three-quarter views on one sheet, the same object in each. Rendered in the same art style as the approved Security and Leather concept references: chunky stylized PBR game art, grimdarked up, worn and used, soft studio light, plain light grey background, no text, no labels.
suit_heater_worn: Concept of the SUIT HEATER module worn: the stout dwarf from the reference wearing the Leather armour set, back three-quarter view, with the suit heater (a glowing orange crystal coil in a dark iron cage wrapped in shaggy woolly hide with leather straps and brass buckles) strapped at the back of his belt, beside the hip. Rendered in the same art style as the approved Security and Leather concept references: chunky stylized PBR game art, grimdarked up, worn and used, soft studio light, plain light grey background, no text, no labels.
